arxiv-2106-15931.title: Informed Machine Learning for Improved Similarity Assessment in Process-Oriented Case-Based Reasoning
arxiv-2106-15931.creator: Maximilian Hoffmann, Ralph Bergmann
arxiv-2106-15931.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Maximilian Hoffmann, Ralph Bergmann. Currently, Deep Learning (DL) components within a Case-Based Reasoning (CBR) application often lack the comprehensive integration of available domain knowledge. The trend within machine learning towards so-called Informed machine learning can help to overcome this limitation. In this paper, we therefore investigate the potential of integrating domain knowledge into Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) that are used for similarity assessment between semantic graphs within process-oriented CBR applications.

arxiv-2210-16983.title: Cosmology in theories with spontaneous scalarization of neutron stars
arxiv-2210-16983.creator: Ratchaphat Nakarachinda 1 , Sirachak Panpanich 2 , Shinji Tsujikawa 2 , and Pitayuth Wongjun 1
arxiv-2210-16983.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ratchaphat Nakarachinda 1 , Sirachak Panpanich 2 , Shinji Tsujikawa 2 , and Pitayuth Wongjun 1. In a model of spontaneous scalarization of neutron stars proposed by Damour and Esposite-Farese, a general relativistic branch becomes unstable to trigger tachyonic growth of a scalar field ϕ \phi toward a scalarized branch. Applying this scenario to cosmology, there is fatal tachyonic instability of ϕ \phi during inflation and matter dominance being incompatible with solar-system constraints on today’s field value ϕ 0 \phi_{0} .

arxiv-2311-00665.title: Surface Geometry of Some Meaningful Extremal Kerr-Newman Black Holes
arxiv-2311-00665.creator: Giorgio SONNINO
arxiv-2311-00665.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Giorgio SONNINO. We address the properties of extremal black holes by considering the Christodoulou-Ruffini/Hawking mass-energy formula. By simple geometrical arguments, we found that the mass/energy formula is satisfied by two meaningful extremal black holes where mass ( m m ), charge ( Q Q ), and angular momentum/spin ( L L ) are proportional to the black holes irreducible mass ( m i ​ r m_{ir} ) expressed by irrational numbers.

arxiv-2406-16078.title: First Heuristic Then Rational: Dynamic Use of Heuristics in Language Model Reasoning
arxiv-2406-16078.creator: Yoichi Aoki, Keito Kudo, Tatsuki Kuribayashi, Shusaku Sone, Masaya Taniguchi, Keisuke Sakaguchi, Kentaro Inui
arxiv-2406-16078.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yoichi Aoki, Keito Kudo, Tatsuki Kuribayashi, Shusaku Sone, Masaya Taniguchi, Keisuke Sakaguchi, Kentaro Inui. Multi-step reasoning instruction, such as chain-of-thought prompting, is widely adopted to explore better language models (LMs) performance. We report on the systematic strategy that LMs employ in such a multi-step reasoning process. Our controlled experiments reveal that LMs rely more heavily on heuristics, such as lexical overlap, in the earlier stages of reasoning, where more reasoning steps remain to reach a goal.

arxiv-2407-13612.title: Rigidity of symmetric frameworks with non-free group actions on the vertices
arxiv-2407-13612.creator: Alison La Porta, Bernd Schulze
arxiv-2407-13612.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alison La Porta, Bernd Schulze. For plane frameworks with reflection or rotational symmetries, where the group action is not necessarily free on the vertex set, we introduce a phase-symmetric orbit rigidity matrix for each irreducible representation of the group. We then use these generalised orbit rigidity matrices to provide necessary conditions for infinitesimal rigidity for frameworks that are symmetric with a cyclic group that acts freely or non-freely on the vertices.

arxiv-2504-00324.title: Atmospheric absorption of dark matter
arxiv-2504-00324.creator: Man Ho Chan
arxiv-2504-00324.description: Abstract Typically, the interaction between dark matter and ordinary matter is assumed to be very small. Nevertheless, in this article, I show that the effective resonant absorption of dark photon dark matter in the atmosphere is definitely possible. This might also be associated with the alleged temperature anomalies observed in our upper stratosphere.

arxiv-2504-05275.title: On Canonical Sandpile Actions of Embedded Graphs
arxiv-2504-05275.creator: Lilla Tóthmérész
arxiv-2504-05275.description: Abstract The sandpile group of a connected graph is a group whose cardinality is the number of spanning trees. The group is known to have a canonical simply transitive action on spanning trees if the graph is embedded into the plane. However, no canonical action on the spanning trees was known for the nonplanar case.

arxiv-2510-07227.title: Where to Begin: Efficient Pretraining via Subnetwork Selection and Distillation
arxiv-2510-07227.creator: Arjun Krishnakumar, Rhea Sanjay Sukthanker, Hannan Javed Mahadik, Gabriela Kadlecová, Vladyslav Moroshan, Timur Carstensen, Frank Hutter, Aaron Klein
arxiv-2510-07227.description: Abstract Small Language models (SLMs) offer an efficient and accessible alternative to Large Language Models (LLMs), delivering strong performance while using far fewer resources. We introduce a simple and effective framework for pretraining SLMs that brings together three complementary ideas.

pmc-10581228.title: The essential role of intestinal microbiota in cytomegalovirus reactivation
pmc-10581228.creator: Chikara Kohda, Satoshi Ino, Hiroki Ishikawa, Yoshihiro Kuno, Ryuichi Nagashima, Masayuki Iyoda
pmc-10581228.description: Human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) is a member of Herpesviridae. It has been reported that HCMV is reactivated in the breast milk of HCMV-seropositive lactating women. As we have reported various aspects of the roles of indigenous microbiota, its role in the murine CMV (MCMV) reactivation was examined in this study.

pmc-10649979.title: Making Moco: A Personal History
pmc-10649979.creator: Sharon J. Nieter Burgmayer
pmc-10649979.description: This contribution describes the path of my nearly forty-year quest to understand the special ligand coordinated to molybdenum and tungsten ions in their respective enzymes. Through this quest, I aimed to discover why nature did not simply use a methyl group on the dithiolene that chelates Mo and W but instead chose a complicated pyranopterin.

pmc-10690061.title: Spontaneous Bladder Rupture After Binge Drinking
pmc-10690061.creator: Jeremy Miller, Andrew McCague
pmc-10690061.description: Spontaneous bladder rupture is a rare cause of the acute abdomen. Alcohol has been described as one of the most common causes of spontaneous bladder rupture. We present the case of a 42-year-old male who presented to our Level I Trauma Center complaining of abdominal pain and difficulty urinating after an evening of drinking.

pmc-10693569.title: Potential window alignment regulating ion transfer in faradaic junctions for efficient photoelectrocatalysis
pmc-10693569.creator: Hongzheng Dong, Xiangyu Pan, Yuancai Gong, Mengfan Xue, Pin Wang, SocMan Ho-Kimura, Yingfang Yao, Hao Xin, Wenjun Luo, Zhigang Zou
pmc-10693569.description: In the past decades, a band alignment theory has become a basis for designing different high-performance semiconductor devices, such as photocatalysis, photoelectrocatalysis, photoelectrostorage and third-generation photovoltaics. Recently, a faradaic junction model (coupled electron and ion transfer) has been proposed to explain charge transfer phenomena in these semiconductor heterojunctions.

pmc-10709280.title: Towards Inferring Network Properties from Epidemic Data
pmc-10709280.creator: Istvan Z Kiss, Luc Berthouze, Wasiur R KhudaBukhsh
pmc-10709280.description: Epidemic propagation on networks represents an important departure from traditional mass-action models. However, the high-dimensionality of the exact models poses a challenge to both mathematical analysis and parameter inference. By using mean-field models, such as the pairwise model (PWM), the high-dimensionality becomes tractable.

pmc-11378937.title: Exploring antidiabetic drug targets as potential disease-modifying agents in osteoarthritis
pmc-11378937.creator: Kai Fu, Shucheng Si, Xinzhong Jin, Yan Zhang, Vicky Duong, Qianying Cai, Guangyi Li, Win Min Oo, Xianyou Zheng, Cindy G Boer, Yuqing Zhang, Xiaojuan Wei, Changqing Zhang, Youshui Gao, David J Hunter
pmc-11378937.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryBackgroundOsteoarthritis is a leading cause of disability, and disease-modifying osteoarthritis drugs (DMOADs) could represent a pivotal advancement in treatment. Identifying the potential of antidiabetic medications as DMOADs could impact patient care significantly.MethodsWe designed a comprehensive analysis pipeline involving two-sample Mendelian Randomization (MR) (genetic proxies for antidiabetic drug targets), summary-based MR (SMR) (for mRNA), and colocalisation (for drug-target genes) to assess their causal relationship with 12 osteoarthritis phenotypes.

pmc-11432211.title: Circular RNAs: Novel Players in Cancer Mechanisms and Therapeutic Strategies
pmc-11432211.creator: Jimi Kim, Stergios Boussios, Matin Sheriff
pmc-11432211.description: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) are a novel class of noncoding RNAs that have emerged as pivotal players in gene regulation. Our understanding of circRNAs has greatly expanded over the last decade, with studies elucidating their biology and exploring their therapeutic applications.

pmc-11470789.title: Antibiotic-resistant Escherichia coli from treated municipal wastewaters and Black-headed Gull nestlings on the recipient river
pmc-11470789.creator: Martina Masarikova, Iva Sukkar, Ivana Jamborova, Matej Medvecky, Ivo Papousek, Ivan Literak, Alois Cizek, Monika Dolejska
pmc-11470789.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Wastewaters belong among the most important sources of environmental pollution, including antibiotic-resistant bacteria. The aim of the study was to evaluate treated wastewaters as a possible transmission pathway for bacterial colonisation of gulls occupying the receiving river. A collection of antibiotic-resistant Escherichia coli originating both from treated municipal wastewaters discharged to the river Svratka (Czech Republic) and nestlings of Black-headed Gull (Chroicocephalus ridibundus) living 35 km downstream of the outlet was obtained using selective cultivation.

pmc-12670528.title: High-Performance Supercapacitors with Femtosecond-Laser-Nanostructured Current Collectors
pmc-12670528.creator: Oleksandr Kuznetsov, Fedir Ivashchyshyn, Andriy Lotnyk, Nils Braun, Andrea Prager, Volodymyr Babizhetskyy, Anatoly V. Zayats, Iaroslav Gnilitskyi
pmc-12670528.description: The interfacial resistance between a current collector and an active material of a supercapacitor leads to energy losses and a decrease in the specific power of the device. In addition, low adhesion of the active material to the collector can cause degradation of the supercapacitor during operation.

pmc-12710600.title: HZO/HSO Superlattice ReFET Array Integrating Optical Sensing for Neuromorphic Vision Computing
pmc-12710600.creator: Bingjie Dang, Kaixuan Sun, Hanxin Su, Jiaxin Chen, Pengyu Yao, Tao Zeng, Shu Shi, Guowei Zhou, Liang Liu, Xiaohong Xu, Jingsheng Chen
pmc-12710600.description: Neuromorphic vision systems require artificial synapses that integrate sensing, memory, and computation with high precision and stability. Conventional memristors face limitations including forming requirements, few multilevel states, low endurance, and poor integration density, while ferroelectric and flash‐based transistors suffer trade‐offs among endurance, retention, and switching ratio, and generally lack intrinsic photonic sensitivity, constraining in‐sensor computing.

pmc-12805272.title: Atrioventricular block in the newborn period
pmc-12805272.creator: Yuval Bitterman, Elizabeth Anne Stephenson
pmc-12805272.description: ence of congenital heart disease, the etiology is most frequently immune-based, thought to be connected to maternal anti-Ro antibodies.2 Patients exhibit fetal bradycardia, classically starting after the second trimester.1,2 The combination of fetal bradycardia, which can be significant, and myocardial inflammation leading to endocardial fibroelastosis together can lead to fetal hydrops and even fetal demise.

pmc-13292200.title: Effects of Supporting Electrolyte and Solvent on the Thermodynamics and Kinetics of Reduction Reactions in a Keggin-Type Polyoxotungstate
pmc-13292200.creator: Hania A. Guirguis, Mamta Dagar, Sophia M. Anderson, Ellen M. Matson, Agnes E. Thorarinsdottir
pmc-13292200.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We report the thermodynamic and kinetic behavior of reduction reactions of the Keggin-type polyoxometalate (POM) [PW12O40]3– ((PW12)3–) in the presence of TBAPF6, KPF6, and LiPF6 supporting electrolytes. Room-temperature electrochemical analyses of (TBA)3(PW12) (TBA+ = tetrabutylammonium) reveal anodic shifts of the second and third reduction potentials in the presence of KPF6 and LiPF6 in acetonitrile (MeCN) and N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF), arising from ion-pairing interactions between the reduced charge states of the POM and alkali cations.

pmc-13295366.title: Rapid Point-of-Care Detection of Dirofilaria immitis and Dirofilaria repens in Canine Blood Using Two Direct Closed-Tube LAMP Assays
pmc-13295366.creator: Zsófia Bujtor, Tünde Földvári, Csaba Pribenszky, Ákos Jerzsele, Petra Zenke
pmc-13295366.description: Simple SummaryHeartworm and skin worm infections in dogs, caused by Dirofilaria parasites, are spreading in many regions and rarely can also pose risks to humans. Early and accurate detection is important for proper treatment and for monitoring the spread of these infections. However, current laboratory methods are often time-consuming and require specialized equipment.

pmc-13445923.title: A machine learning-based interpretable model for predicting pancreatic cancer in chronic pancreatitis patients with focal pancreatic lesions
pmc-13445923.creator: Jin-Hui Yi, Teng Wang, Ya-Wei Bi, Jin-Jie Xu, Miao Liu, Guang-Ming Chen, Zhao-Shen Li, Dan Wang, Ning-Li Chai, Liang-Hao Hu
pmc-13445923.description: BackgroundPancreatic cancer (PC) is deadly and distinguishing it from inflammatory conditions in chronic pancreatitis (CP) patients is challenging. We aimed to develop machine learning models to predict PC in CP patients with focal pancreatic lesions.MethodsFor this bicentric retrospective study, CP patients with indeterminate focal pancreatic lesions discovered through contrast-enhanced computed tomography scans were enrolled.

pmc-13682094.title: Latent class analysis of multimorbidity patterns and associated factors among older adult fallers in the hospital
pmc-13682094.creator: Xinyun Wang, Lili Sun, Lijuan Quan, Minglu Fan, Zhaodi Wang
pmc-13682094.description: BackgroundFalls among older adults in hospitals remain a frequent occurrence, and multimorbidity is significantly associated with this adverse event. However, research on multimorbidity patterns specifically among older hospitalized patients who experienced falls remains limited. This study aimed to identify multimorbidity classes and their associated factors in this population.
